content.text: Two wakings at 19 months is really common, and it usually sticks around because he's learned to expect something at 2am, like a feed, rocking, or a parent lying down. Tonight, when he wakes, keep it short and boring. Go in, give a quick low-voice reassurance, and leave while he's still drowsy. Don't pick him up or turn on the light, and skip anything you wouldn't want to repeat every night. Doing the same thing each time is what teaches him he can settle himself.
